purpose: Every secret and configuration NAME the US backend needs, where it lives and who reads it. Values are never stored in the repository.
verified: Vault names: production F2A b13 (2026-10-03). Edge env names: every Deno.env.get in supabase/functions. Consumers: repo source (tests/f2a1-production-baseline.test.js keeps this file in sync). F2C (2026-10-04): us_project_url and VAPID_SUBJECT are new configuration names, required before the F2C rollout; production vault names re-read read-only.

vault.name: us_monthiversary_cron_key
vault.created_by: production only; by its ledger name most likely 20260820181734 us_monthiversary_scheduler (inferred). Provision by hand on a new project

vault.name: us_project_url
vault.created_by: provisioned by hand (F2C rollout step 2, before the migration): the project origin https://<ref>.supabase.co, no trailing path. Not a secret, but project-specific, so it never lives in the repo

vault.name: us_left_for_you_cleanup_cron_key
vault.created_by: NOT provisioned in the repo/local pass. Provision by hand in Vault before deploying cleanup-left-for-you; enable its paused job only after the off-site logical DB dump gate in F2A3_ROLLOUT.md

vault.name: us_web_push_vapid_private
vault.created_by: production only; by its ledger name most likely 20260820003406 web_push_vapid_vault_access (inferred). Provision by hand on a new project
vault.pairs_with: VAPID public key hard-coded in the Edge sources and the client (public by design)

edge_env.name: SUPABASE_URL
edge_env.store: platform (injected by Supabase into every Edge Function)

edge_env.name: VAPID_SUBJECT
edge_env.store: Edge Function secret (supabase secrets set). Web Push sender contact, https: or mailto:; provision before deploying any F2C push function (they fail closed without it)
